purpose: Teach: 北方/ケネディ/都立/近鉄/東急/Ｊリーグ/エンジニアリング/デスノート

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で北方領土習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you studied the Northern Territories in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation, like she's caught him in something. Quick, teasing rhythm. Eyes bright with the setup of a joke coming.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でケネディ政権習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You studied Kennedy's presidency in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Rapid volley back. He's anticipating where she's going. Slight smirk in the voice — not defensive, matching her energy exactly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、都立高校志望だったな
lines.en: Riku, you were aiming to get into Toritsu High School, weren't you?
lines.style: Shift to a new lane. Still teasing but softer — this fact actually means something to her. Brief pause before the name, like she's remembering.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、近鉄バファローズ応援してたな、桜
lines.en: You were a huge Kintetsu Buffaloes fan, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: He pivots smoothly. Not angry — just keeping pace. There's a private satisfaction in knowing these small details about her. Even rhythm, steady gaze.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、東急沿線で部活してたな
lines.en: Riku, you did club activities along the Tokyu line, didn't you?
lines.style: Another gear shift upward. She's building something — each fact a small brick. Voice quickens slightly, a little breathless with momentum.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、Ｊリーグ全クラブ覚えてたな、桜
lines.en: You memorized every single J-League club, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: He's keeping up perfectly. Slight laugh underneath — admiration mixed with the teasing. Leans into the absurdity of the detail.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、エンジニアリング学部志望だったな
lines.en: Riku, you were aiming for an engineering major, weren't you?
lines.style: Rapid-fire now. She's not pausing between facts. Voice climbs slightly — the rhythm matters more than the individual words. Building to something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、デスノート全巻持ってたな、桜
lines.en: You owned the entire Death Note manga series, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final fact lands with quiet certainty. Slight pause after her name. His voice softens — this is the last one, and he knows what she's really saying. Closer, almost whispered.
